text:
mina: Quick heads-up — hitting a parity bug in Node SDK v1.8.x when using json mode + function calls. Sample app validator expects an object but occasionally receives a single-element array and errors out.

raoul: repro steps? which sample app?

mina: samplekit onboarding flow, call to `extract_entities` with `mode: 'json'` and `jsonSchema` for an object. Intermittent. Minimal client call:```js
await client.call({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  mode: 'json',
  function: 'extract_entities',
  jsonSchema: entitySchema,
  input: text
})
```
Sometimes parsed result is `[{"entities": [...] }]` instead of `{"entities": [...]}` and our validator throws `TypeError: entities is undefined`.

ivy: Only on Node? Python ok?

mina: Python 0.9.x seems fine in quick checks. Node reproduces reliably if you force a retry (flip a 502 during the stream). Points to retry + streaming join parity gap.

dev-bot: :warning: alert json_parse_shape_mismatch=5 service=samplekit env=staging

raoul: Stack trace from sample app:```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'entities' of undefined
    at /app/src/runner.js:56:18
    at async handleCall (/app/src/server.js:102:7)
```

lee: Hypothesis: streaming parser accumulates fragments in an array during partial parses, and when retry merges frames a normalization/unbox step is skipped. Could be double-parse path in retry wrapper.

mina: Temporary mitigation added to samplekit: small normalize helper that coerces single-element arrays into element when `schema.type === 'object'`. Example:```js
function normalize(parsed, schema) {
  if (schema?.type === 'object' && Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length === 1) return parsed[0];
  return parsed;
}
```
We added it behind a flag and it reduces customer errors.

ivy: Can you open an issue and add a small e2e that simulates a mid-stream 502? I'll pair on the retry parsing audit.

mina: Issue filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/issues/2077 with a tiny harness that flips a 502 at token 2. Also added a failing unit test that demonstrates array-wrap on retry.

raoul: Plan: raoul to open a WIP PR in node-sdk to add narrowly-scoped normalization only when `mode==='json' && function_call && schema.type==='object'` and only for single-element arrays. ivy to add integration test against samplekit harness. lee to audit streaming parser join logic to ensure no double-parse / unintended array wrapping. Add metric `jsonmode.single_array_unwrap_count`.

support: Draft support blurb: "If your app using Node SDK sees parse errors with json mode function calls, upgrade to the patch release which normalizes single-element array wrapping in retry scenarios, or add the provided normalize helper in samplekit. Contact eng-devex for repro access."

dev-bot: :white_check_mark: CI queued for node-sdk/pr-2077 - unit + samplekit e2e

mina: One more note: please do NOT silently coerce multi-element arrays to single objects. The normalization must only apply to single-element arrays and be flagged with metrics. We'll discuss stricter schema semantics in the RFC follow-up.

lee: Agreed. Also add a changelog + migration note for samplekit docs.

mina: Thanks all — ping me if you want staging creds to repro.

(ends)
